rows.note: Use this for taking money out of a bank account or other deposit.

example.english: I’m going to withdraw money from my bank account at the ATM.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 tai4 fun2

rows.note: Use 收返 as the all-purpose choice when physically pulling something back or taking back something previously given or allowed.

example.english: When a car comes too close, I immediately withdraw my foot.
example.traditional: 架車埋到嚟，我就即刻收返隻腳。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 maai4 dou3 lai4 ngo5 zau6 zik1 hak1 sau1 faan1 zek3 goek3

rows.note: Use this when withdrawing means leaving a place or someone's presence.

example.english: I have something to do, so I need to withdraw from the meeting early.
example.traditional: 我有事，要早啲離開個會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 si6 jiu3 zou2 di1 lei4 hoi1 go3 wui6
